r12.sql:
SELECT picked.token_id, picked.event_type
FROM (
  SELECT t.token_id, s.event_type,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.token_id ORDER BY s.event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT e.event_time,
           get_json_object(e.payload, '$.token_list') AS token_list,
           get_json_object(e.payload, '$.event_type') AS event_type
    FROM demo.station_events e
    WHERE get_json_object(e.payload, '$.region') IS NOT NULL
  ) s
  LATERAL VIEW explode(demo.decode_token_list(s.token_list)) t AS token_id
) picked
WHERE picked.rn = 1

                str_to_map(e.attributes, '&', '=')['display_mode']) AS display_mode
